label: Midterm 2

coverage.text: Fall 2026 Midterm 2 (computer-based, week of 10/5, one-hour slot, 20 points; retakes 10/19–10/20 and 11/5–11/6) covers content through Lecture 14: Linked Lists.

advice: Prof. DeNero’s suggested practice (Ed): start with the PrairieLearn practice exam, then his past-exam picks, marked ★ here. You don’t need to do all of them. His picks from exams not on this site: Fall 2022 Q5(a); Fall 2021 Q2(b) and Q4(b)–(c); Fall 2020 Q2(b); Fall 2019 Q4 and Q6; Fall 2018 Q2 and Q4(a)–(b); Fall 2017 Q3(a)–(c) and Q4(a), (c); Fall 2015 Q3(e) (challenge); Fall 2014 Q3(a)–(b).

scope.note: Problems are included when every topic the course staff tagged them with is covered by Midterm 2 (through linked lists; trees, mutation and classes come later). That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation. Midterm 1 topics are fair game too; switch to Midterm 1 for those exams.

timed.intro: Each exam draws original past exam problems in Midterm 2’s scope at random, mixing recursion, tree recursion, lists and linked lists. They aren’t modified, so you may have seen some of them already.

exams.note: Prof. DeNero recommends 4(a)–(b) and 6(a)–(b) for Midterm 2 (marked ★).
